records.statement: KTM's 2020 owner's manual for the 85 SX: the top clamp has two bar-mount holes 15 mm apart and the bar-mount holes sit 3.5 mm off centre, so the bar can go in four positions; clutch lever reach is set to hand size with a hand-turned adjusting screw (limited range, never forced); the front brake lever screw sets free travel, which moves the pressure point closer to or away from the bar, rather than lever reach; the front brake lever must keep free travel of at least 3 mm; rear brake pedal height is set with a stop screw (limited range), then the push rod is reset so the pedal keeps 3-5 mm free travel; the shift lever can be refitted on the shaft splines to raise or lower it, as long as it touches nothing while shifting.

source.name: KTM Owner's Manual 2020 (85 SX), art. no. 3213998en
